verseOfDay.text: And forthwith Jesus obliged his disciples to go up into the boat, and to go before him over the water, till he dismissed the people.

prayer.title: Prayer to My Guardian Angel
prayer.text:
Angel of God, my guardian dear,
to whom God's love commits me here,
ever this day be at my side,
to light and guard, to rule and guide.
Amen.
prayer.note: A child’s prayer that grown men should keep saying, especially on the road.

consider.question: Why pray to saints instead of to God?
consider.answer: Asking a saint to pray for you is the same thing as asking a friend to pray for you, except that this friend is already with God. It is intercession, not worship — worship belongs to God alone. The saints do not compete with Christ; they are the proof of what he does with a life.
